capabilities: Syncs vault files bi-directionally through an S3-compatible bucket
Creates scheduled backup snapshots with age- or count-based retention
Encrypts synced files and backups with a passphrase
Writes LOCAL_ and REMOTE_ copies when a file conflicts
Downloads a backup snapshot as a ZIP file
extras: A lost passphrase cannot be recovered; the README advises against running it alongside Obsidian Sync; mobile background limits may delay sync; credentials are moved to Obsidian's Keychain, which needs Obsidian 1.11.5 or later.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to keep a vault synchronized or take scheduled snapshots to your own S3-compatible storage.

relations.evidence: Works with AWS S3, Cloudflare R2, Backblaze B2, RustFS, and any other S3-compatible endpoint.

requires.name: S3 access key ID and secret access key

summary: Syncs vault files across devices and makes scheduled backups through S3-compatible storage, with optional end-to-end encryption.
